content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am writing to propose a few small changes to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on scope, you are required to perform changes and extra work without additional pay as long as they fit within the overall project budget, and I propose that client may request changes to scope, but any such changes will be subject to a mutually agreed written change order adjusting the project fee and timeline. - Regarding the relevant clause on revisions, the contract allows an excessive 15 rounds of revisions before additional charges apply, which can consume significant uncompensated time, and I propose that the parties agree to include up to two rounds of revisions for the principal creative Deliverables, with any further revisions subject to additional fees. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment, payment is due within 60 days of invoice, which significantly delays your cash flow, and I propose that invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you for your time and cooperation.
